UK Court of Appeal gives Microsoft complaint the green light

The ValueLicensing complaint against Microsoft is being upheld following a Court of Appeal ruling . The Court of Appeal unanimously upheld the Competition Appeal Tribunal’s (CAT) decisions in the pre-owned software reseller’s ongoing abuse of dominance competition law claim against Microsoft.
